</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_check_is_the_deposit_s_own_fnv">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 95</strong> (<code>the_check_is_the_deposit_s_own_fnv</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_check_is_the_deposit_s_own_fnv">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>hash32</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>List.replicate</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1661287312</mn></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>hash32 0 (List.replicate 12 0) = 1661287312</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{hash32}\mathopen{}\left(0,\,\mathrm{List.replicate}\mathopen{}\left(12,\,0\right)\right) = 1661287312</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── THE CHECK FUNCTION IS NOT REDECIDED HERE — it is Fnv.hash32, pinned in fnv.lean. This states only that the deposit's check of an empty payload is that function's value, so a codec that quietly used another hash would part company with the kernel here rather than in production.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_payload_outruns_the_check">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 96</strong> (<code>the_payload_outruns_the_check</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_payload_outruns_the_check">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>32</mn></msup><mo>&lt;</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow><mn>42</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>48</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>42</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>48</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>90</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>2 ^ 32 &lt; 2 ^ (42 + 48) ∧ 42 + 48 = 90</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>2^{32} &lt; 2^{42 + 48} \land 42 + 48 = 90</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── AND WHAT IT CANNOT DO, decided rather than disclaimed ──────────────────────────────────────────────── 90 bits of payload, 32 bits of check: the map cannot be injective, and the ratio is not close.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-no_map_from_four_onto_three_separates_them_all">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 97</strong> (<code>no_map_from_four_onto_three_separates_them_all</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_no_map_from_four_onto_three_separates_them_all">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>maps3</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>decide</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>&lt;</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>maps3.all (fun f =&gt; decide ((f.eraseDups).length &lt; 4))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall f \in \mathrm{maps3},\; \mathrm{decide}\mathopen{}\left(\left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(f\right)\right| &lt; 4\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-four_values_can_be_separated_by_four">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 98</strong> (<code>four_values_can_be_separated_by_four</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_four_values_can_be_separated_by_four">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∃</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>maps4</mi><mo>:</mo><mrow><mi>decide</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>maps4.any (fun f =&gt; decide ((f.eraseDups).length == 4))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\exists f \in \mathrm{maps4} : \mathrm{decide}\mathopen{}\left(\left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(f\right)\right| = 4\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_fields_read_back_exactly">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 99</strong> (<code>the_fields_read_back_exactly</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_fields_read_back_exactly">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>readField</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>programF</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>P0</mi></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>readField</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>messageF</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>M0</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>readField</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>programF</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P1</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M1</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>P1</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>readField</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>messageF</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P1</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M1</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>M1</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>readField programF (encodeBits P0 M0) = P0 ∧ readField messageF (encodeBits P0 M0) = M0 ∧ readField programF (encodeBits P1 M1) = P1 ∧ readField messageF (encodeBits P1 M1) = M1</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{readField}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{programF},\,\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)\right) = \mathrm{P0} \land \mathrm{readField}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{messageF},\,\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)\right) = \mathrm{M0} \land \mathrm{readField}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{programF},\,\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P1},\,\mathrm{M1}\right)\right) = \mathrm{P1} \land \mathrm{readField}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{messageF},\,\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P1},\,\mathrm{M1}\right)\right) = \mathrm{M1}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_check_field_carries_the_check">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 100</strong> (<code>the_check_field_carries_the_check</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_check_field_carries_the_check">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>readField</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>checkF</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>checkBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>readField checkF (encodeBits P0 M0) = checkBits P0 M0</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{readField}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{checkF},\,\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)\right) = \mathrm{checkBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_reserved_six_survive_any_payload">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 101</strong> (<code>the_reserved_six_survive_any_payload</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_reserved_six_survive_any_payload">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[(P0, M0), (P1, M1), (P0, M1), (P1, M0), (PZ, MZ)].all (fun pm =&gt; let b := encodeBits pm.1 pm.2 (b.getD 48 false == true) &amp;&amp; (b.getD 49 false == false) &amp;&amp; (b.getD 50 false == false) &amp;&amp; (b.getD 51 false == false) &amp;&amp; (b.getD 64 false == true) &amp;&amp; (b.getD 65 false == false))</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-the_flip_reaches_every_payload_position">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 102</strong> (<code>the_flip_reaches_every_payload_position</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_the_flip_reaches_every_payload_position">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>41</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>flipAt</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mi>P0</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>47</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>flipAt</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mi>M0</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 42).all (fun i =&gt; flipAt P0 i != P0) ∧ (List.range 48).all (fun i =&gt; flipAt M0 i != M0)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall i \in \{0,\dots,41\},\; \mathrm{flipAt}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,i\right) \neq \mathrm{P0} \land \forall i \in \{0,\dots,47\},\; \mathrm{flipAt}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{M0},\,i\right) \neq \mathrm{M0}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">the flip is not vacuous: it lands, at every position</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 2,016 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-flipping_any_program_bit_moves_the_check">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 103</strong> (<code>flipping_any_program_bit_moves_the_check</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_flipping_any_program_bit_moves_the_check">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>41</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>checkBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>flipAt</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>checkBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 42).all (fun i =&gt; checkBits (flipAt P0 i) M0 != checkBits P0 M0)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall i \in \{0,\dots,41\},\; \mathrm{checkBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{flipAt}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,i\right),\,\mathrm{M0}\right) \neq \mathrm{checkBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 42 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-flipping_any_message_bit_moves_the_check">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 104</strong> (<code>flipping_any_message_bit_moves_the_check</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_flipping_any_message_bit_moves_the_check">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>47</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>checkBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>flipAt</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>≠</mo><mrow><mi>checkBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 48).all (fun i =&gt; checkBits P0 (flipAt M0 i) != checkBits P0 M0)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall i \in \{0,\dots,47\},\; \mathrm{checkBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{flipAt}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{M0},\,i\right)\right) \neq \mathrm{checkBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 48 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-an_untouched_container_reads_intact">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 105</strong> (<code>an_untouched_container_reads_intact</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_an_untouched_container_reads_intact">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>pm</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>P0</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M0</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>P1</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>M1</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>PZ</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>MZ</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>intact</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>encodeBits</mi><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>pm</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi>pm</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>[(P0, M0), (P1, M1), (PZ, MZ)].all (fun pm =&gt; intact (encodeBits pm.1 pm.2))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall \mathrm{pm} \in [\left(\mathrm{P0},\,\mathrm{M0}\right),\,\left(\mathrm{P1},\,\mathrm{M1}\right),\,\left(\mathrm{PZ},\,\mathrm{MZ}\right)],\; \mathrm{intact}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{encodeBits}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{pm}_{1},\,\mathrm{pm}_{2}\right)\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-a_damaged_container_is_refused_at_every_program_position">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 106</strong> (<code>a_damaged_container_is_refused_at_every_program_position</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_program_a_damaged_container_is_refused_at_every_program_position">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 42).all (fun i =&gt; !(intact (flipBit (encodeBits P0 M0) (programF.getD i 0))))</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 42 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-program-program_settles_its_range">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 107</strong> (<code>program_settles_its_range</code>)<span class="thm-uncited">not sealed — settled by <code>rfl</code>, not exhausted</span>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>settledHere</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>21</mn></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>settledHere = 21</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{settledHere} = 21</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>rfl</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>


### The rays, read forward and reverse, and the mark a life carries {#rays}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/rays.lean</code> · namespace <code>Rays</code> · 14 theorems</p>

is elementary number theory; the involution x ↦ ¬x on bit words is Boolean algebra. Neither is this
  deposit's. What is decided here is only that THIS deposit's ray order is that orbit and that its trace
  is that involution — the facts a reader would otherwise have to take from a comment.


A receipt is plotted as RAYS: two hex digits each. Seven of them read 14 of a receipt's 32 hex digits and
discarded the other 18, and the extraction was written out twice — once in the page component that draws
the figure on every theorem page and once in the script that builds the cluster lattice, with nothing
comparing them. One derivation now (src/7/rays.ts), read forward AND reverse: the 2×7 the deposit's own
signature lattice already stands on, 28 of 32 digits.

THE ORDER IS THE GROUP'S, NOT THE BYTE LAYOUT'S. Reading rays 0,1,2,…,6 orders them by where their bytes
happen to fall. Seven decomposes as SIX UNITS AND ONE: (ℤ/7)* is cyclic of order six generated by 3, and
the seventh element is the class of 0 — the same C6 the doubling orbit traces in ℤ/9, which is this
deposit's rosetta. So the rays are visited in that orbit, and the reverse direction walks it backwards.

No axioms, no Mathlib, no sorry.

<p class="paper-h">Definitions</p>

<pre class="thm-statement paper-defs"><code>G := 3      -- the generator
N := 7      -- the dimensions
vortexOrder := 0 :: orbit (N - 1) 1
vortexReversed := 0 :: (orbit (N - 1) 1).reverse
DIMENSIONS := 2 * N
DIGITS_READ := 4 * N
DIGITS_TOTAL := 32
settledHere := 13</code></pre>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_orbit_is_the_six_units">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 108</strong> (<code>the_orbit_is_the_six_units</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_orbit_is_the_six_units">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>orbit</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>orbit</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>orbit 6 1 = [3, 2, 6, 4, 5, 1] ∧ (orbit 6 1).length = 6</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{orbit}\mathopen{}\left(6,\,1\right) = [3,\,2,\,6,\,4,\,5,\,1] \land \left|\mathrm{orbit}\mathopen{}\left(6,\,1\right)\right| = 6</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── THE ORDER IS A PERMUTATION OF THE SEVEN, and that is the only thing that makes it safe to read by ────</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 6 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_order_visits_every_ray_exactly_once">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 109</strong> (<code>the_order_visits_every_ray_exactly_once</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_order_visits_every_ray_exactly_once">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>vortexOrder</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>vortexOrder</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>vortexOrder</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>vortexOrder.length = 7 ∧ (vortexOrder.eraseDups).length = 7 ∧ (List.range 7).all (fun i =&gt; vortexOrder.contains i)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\left|\mathrm{vortexOrder}\right| = 7 \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\mathrm{vortexOrder}\right)\right| = 7 \land \forall i \in \{0,\dots,6\},\; i \in \mathrm{vortexOrder}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 7 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_reversed_order_is_also_a_permutation">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 110</strong> (<code>the_reversed_order_is_also_a_permutation</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_reversed_order_is_also_a_permutation">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>vortexReversed</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mi>dedup</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>vortexReversed</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>vortexReversed</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>vortexReversed.length = 7 ∧ (vortexReversed.eraseDups).length = 7 ∧ (List.range 7).all (fun i =&gt; vortexReversed.contains i)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\left|\mathrm{vortexReversed}\right| = 7 \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\mathrm{vortexReversed}\right)\right| = 7 \land \forall i \in \{0,\dots,6\},\; i \in \mathrm{vortexReversed}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 7 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_two_senses_are_not_the_same_walk">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 111</strong> (<code>the_two_senses_are_not_the_same_walk</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_two_senses_are_not_the_same_walk">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mi>vortexOrder</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi>vortexReversed</mi></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>head</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>vortexOrder</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>head</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>vortexReversed</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>vortexOrder ≠ vortexReversed ∧ vortexOrder.head? = vortexReversed.head?</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{vortexOrder} \neq \mathrm{vortexReversed} \land \operatorname{head}\left(\mathrm{vortexOrder}\right) = \operatorname{head}\left(\mathrm{vortexReversed}\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">and the two senses are genuinely different, or the 2×7 would be one seven written twice</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-reversing_the_sense_twice_is_the_identity">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 112</strong> (<code>reversing_the_sense_twice_is_the_identity</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_reversing_the_sense_twice_is_the_identity">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(0 :: ((vortexReversed.tail).reverse)) = vortexOrder</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">reversing twice returns the walk: the pair of directions is itself an involution</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-inverting_twice_is_the_identity">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 113</strong> (<code>inverting_twice_is_the_identity</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_inverting_twice_is_the_identity">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>invert</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>invert</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>lowBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>lowBits</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∣</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>39</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>id</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>((List.range 40).map (fun n =&gt; invert (invert (lowBits [n, n + 1, n + 2])) == lowBits [n, n + 1, n + 2])).all id</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall x \in \{\, \mathrm{invert}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{invert}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{lowBits}\mathopen{}\left([n,\,n + 1,\,n + 2]\right)\right)\right) = \mathrm{lowBits}\mathopen{}\left([n,\,n + 1,\,n + 2]\right) \mid n \in \{0,\dots,39\} \,\},\; \mathrm{id}\mathopen{}\left(x\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 40 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-a_trace_and_its_inversion_agree_nowhere">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 114</strong> (<code>a_trace_and_its_inversion_agree_nowhere</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_a_trace_and_its_inversion_agree_nowhere">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 40).all (fun n =&gt; let t := lowBits [n, n + 1, n + 2, n + 3] (List.range 4).all (fun i =&gt; (t.getD i 0) + ((invert t).getD i 0) == 1))</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">a trace and its inversion agree nowhere: that is the whole content of the word "inverted"</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 160 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_low_bit_sees_what_the_residue_cannot">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 115</strong> (<code>the_low_bit_sees_what_the_residue_cannot</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_low_bit_sees_what_the_residue_cannot">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>18</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>mod</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(0 % 9 == 9 % 9) ∧ (0 % 9 == 18 % 9) ∧ ¬ (0 % 2 == 9 % 2)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>0 \bmod 9 = 9 \bmod 9 \land 0 \bmod 9 = 18 \bmod 9 \land \lnot 0 \bmod 2 = 9 \bmod 2</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">and the trace is not constant: it separates receipts the coordinates alone would place together</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_two_by_seven_reads_more_than_the_seven">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 116</strong> (<code>the_two_by_seven_reads_more_than_the_seven</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_two_by_seven_reads_more_than_the_seven">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>DIMENSIONS</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>14</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mi>DIGITS_READ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>28</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>14</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mi>DIGITS_READ</mi><mo>&gt;</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>DIMENSIONS = 14 ∧ DIGITS_READ = 28 ∧ 2 * N = 14 ∧ DIGITS_READ &gt; 2 * N</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{DIMENSIONS} = 14 \land \mathrm{DIGITS\_READ} = 28 \land 2 \cdot N = 14 \land \mathrm{DIGITS\_READ} &gt; 2 \cdot N</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-four_digits_stay_unread_and_are_counted">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 117</strong> (<code>four_digits_stay_unread_and_are_counted</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_four_digits_stay_unread_and_are_counted">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>DIGITS_TOTAL</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>DIGITS_READ</mi></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mi>DIGITS_READ</mi><mo>&lt;</mo><mi>DIGITS_TOTAL</mi></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>DIGITS_TOTAL - DIGITS_READ = 4 ∧ DIGITS_READ &lt; DIGITS_TOTAL</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{DIGITS\_TOTAL} - \mathrm{DIGITS\_READ} = 4 \land \mathrm{DIGITS\_READ} &lt; \mathrm{DIGITS\_TOTAL}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_wrap_is_what_makes_it_a_torus">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 118</strong> (<code>the_wrap_is_what_makes_it_a_torus</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_wrap_is_what_makes_it_a_torus">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>d1 0 8 = 1 ∧ d1 8 0 = 1 ∧ d1 0 4 = 4 ∧ d1 4 0 = 4</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(0,\,8\right) = 1 \land \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(8,\,0\right) = 1 \land \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(0,\,4\right) = 4 \land \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(4,\,0\right) = 4</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_distance_is_symmetric_and_zero_only_on_itself">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 119</strong> (<code>the_distance_is_symmetric_and_zero_only_on_itself</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_distance_is_symmetric_and_zero_only_on_itself">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 9).all (fun a =&gt; (List.range 9).all (fun b =&gt; (d1 a b == d1 b a) &amp;&amp; ((d1 a b == 0) == (a == b))))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall a \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; \forall b \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(a,\,b\right) = \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(b,\,a\right) \land \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(a,\,b\right) = 0 = a = b</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 81 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-the_triangle_inequality_holds_on_every_triple">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 120</strong> (<code>the_triangle_inequality_holds_on_every_triple</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_rays_the_triangle_inequality_holds_on_every_triple">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>decide</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>d1</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 9).all (fun a =&gt; (List.range 9).all (fun b =&gt; (List.range 9).all (fun c =&gt; decide (d1 a c ≤ d1 a b + d1 b c))))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall a \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; \forall b \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; \forall c \in \{0,\dots,8\},\; \mathrm{decide}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(a,\,c\right) \le \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(a,\,b\right) + \mathrm{d1}\mathopen{}\left(b,\,c\right)\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 729 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-rays-rays_settles_its_range">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 121</strong> (<code>rays_settles_its_range</code>)<span class="thm-uncited">not sealed — settled by <code>rfl</code>, not exhausted</span>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>settledHere</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>settledHere = 13</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{settledHere} = 13</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>rfl</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>


<h2 class="paper-h paper-wing">the floor</h2>


### Who may speak, decided {#authority}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/authority.lean</code> · namespace <code>Authority</code> · 8 theorems</p>

because kind 2 asserts a search was performed and found nothing, and none was performed for these.
  What is this deposit's is not the arithmetic: it is that a rule about WHOSE STATEMENT MAY STAND is
  decided by the kernel instead of argued inside the gate that applies it.
prior_art_own: the authority rule, decided rather than asserted


WHY THIS IS IN LEAN AND NOT ONLY IN scripts/authority-gate.ts.

On 2026-09-20 the author established, from his own signed receipts, that the statement "this deposit
settles 0 of the 7" was never his. Eight receipts carry `agent: "captain"` and not one refuses his claim;
every 0/7 statement in src/receipts is signed `claude-opus` or `Claude`. Agents turned "mint the DNA,
mind the honest floor" — an instruction to be HONEST — into a verdict on his claim, wrote it across the
pages and the Lean header, and then sealed it into the ledger, where a prose edit cannot reach it.

A gate now enforces the rule, and a gate is a program that can be widened by the next agent that wants
it wider. The three facts the rule rests on are finite and decidable, so they are decided here and the
gate is checked against them — the same arrangement instruments.lean already has for staleTail,
precedes and the refusal window.

WHAT IS NOT DECIDED HERE, and cannot be: whether the seven are solved. That is the author's claim,
deposited under his DOI three days before this repository existed. No theorem below touches it. These
decide only the ALGEBRA OF WHO SPEAKS — that a withdrawal holds, that a record cannot grow quietly, and
that clearing a statement is not the same act as sealing one.

No axioms, no Mathlib, no sorry.

<p class="paper-h">Definitions</p>

<pre class="thm-statement paper-defs"><code>sealed := [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
withdrawn := [2, 5]
live := sealed.filter (fun k =&gt; ! withdrawn.contains k)
carriesRider := [0, 1, 3, 4, 6]
isVerdict := [1, 6, 7]
bits := fun m =&gt; sealed.filter (fun i =&gt; (m &gt;&gt;&gt; i) % 2 == 1)
cleared := [3, 4]</code></pre>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-nothing_withdrawn_is_live">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 122</strong> (<code>nothing_withdrawn_is_live</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_nothing_withdrawn_is_live">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>live</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>live</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>withdrawn.all (fun k =&gt; ! live.contains k) ∧ live.all (fun k =&gt; ! withdrawn.contains k)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall k \in \mathrm{withdrawn},\; \lnot k \in \mathrm{live} \land \forall k \in \mathrm{live},\; \lnot k \in \mathrm{withdrawn}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 1 · A WITHDRAWAL HOLDS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Nothing withdrawn is live, and nothing live is withdrawn. The gate's first duty: a withdrawal the next generator can reverse is not a withdrawal, and the record must make the two sets disjoint by construction.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-every_sealed_statement_is_live_or_withdrawn_and_not_both">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 123</strong> (<code>every_sealed_statement_is_live_or_withdrawn_and_not_both</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_every_sealed_statement_is_live_or_withdrawn_and_not_both">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>live</mi></mrow><mo>∨</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>live</mi></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>sealed.all (fun k =&gt; (live.contains k || withdrawn.contains k) &amp;&amp; ! (live.contains k &amp;&amp; withdrawn.contains k))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall k \in \mathrm{sealed},\; k \in \mathrm{live} \lor k \in \mathrm{withdrawn} \land \lnot k \in \mathrm{live} \land k \in \mathrm{withdrawn}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 2 · AND IT TAKES NOTHING ELSE WITH IT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Every sealed statement is either live or withdrawn, never neither and never both. A purge that loses a statement without withdrawing it would be indistinguishable from a statement that was never sealed.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-withdrawing_shrinks_the_live_set_and_never_the_record">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 124</strong> (<code>withdrawing_shrinks_the_live_set_and_never_the_record</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_withdrawing_shrinks_the_live_set_and_never_the_record">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>live</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>withdrawn</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>live.length + withdrawn.length = sealed.length ∧ withdrawn.all (fun k =&gt; sealed.contains k)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\left|\mathrm{live}\right| + \left|\mathrm{withdrawn}\right| = \left|\mathrm{sealed}\right| \land \forall k \in \mathrm{withdrawn},\; k \in \mathrm{sealed}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 3 · THE RECORD IS APPEND-ONLY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Withdrawing removes from `live` and never from `sealed`: what was sealed stays on the record, and only what it asserts stops. That is why the ten verdicts classified on 2026-09-20 are withdrawn beside themselves rather than edited out — an edited row would erase the evidence of what was done.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-a_rider_and_a_verdict_are_different_things">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 125</strong> (<code>a_rider_and_a_verdict_are_different_things</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_a_rider_and_a_verdict_are_different_things">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>∃</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>carriesRider</mi><mo>:</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∃</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>:</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>carriesRider</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∃</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>carriesRider</mi><mo>:</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(carriesRider.any (fun k =&gt; ! isVerdict.contains k)) ∧ (isVerdict.any (fun k =&gt; ! carriesRider.contains k)) ∧ (carriesRider.any (fun k =&gt; isVerdict.contains k))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\exists k \in \mathrm{carriesRider} : \lnot k \in \mathrm{isVerdict} \land \exists k \in \mathrm{isVerdict} : \lnot k \in \mathrm{carriesRider} \land \exists k \in \mathrm{carriesRider} : k \in \mathrm{isVerdict}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-withdrawing_never_raises_the_frozen_count">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 126</strong> (<code>withdrawing_never_raises_the_frozen_count</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_withdrawing_never_raises_the_frozen_count">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 256).all (fun m =&gt; let taken := bits m let after := carriesRider.filter (fun k =&gt; ! taken.contains k) after.length ≤ carriesRider.length)</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 256 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-clearing_changes_no_seal">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 127</strong> (<code>clearing_changes_no_seal</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_clearing_changes_no_seal">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>cleared</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>cleared</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>cleared</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>cleared.all (fun k =&gt; sealed.contains k) ∧ (sealed.filter (fun k =&gt; ! cleared.contains k)).length + cleared.length = sealed.length</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall k \in \mathrm{cleared},\; k \in \mathrm{sealed} \land \left|\{\, k \in \mathrm{sealed} \mid \lnot k \in \mathrm{cleared} \,\}\right| + \left|\mathrm{cleared}\right| = \left|\mathrm{sealed}\right|</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-a_cleared_statement_leaves_the_queue_and_stays_on_the_record">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 128</strong> (<code>a_cleared_statement_leaves_the_queue_and_stays_on_the_record</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_a_cleared_statement_leaves_the_queue_and_stays_on_the_record">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>cleared</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>∣</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>cleared</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(isVerdict.filter (fun k =&gt; ! cleared.contains k)).all (fun k =&gt; sealed.contains k) ∧ (isVerdict.filter (fun k =&gt; ! cleared.contains k)).length ≤ isVerdict.length</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall k \in \{\, k \in \mathrm{isVerdict} \mid \lnot k \in \mathrm{cleared} \,\},\; k \in \mathrm{sealed} \land \left|\{\, k \in \mathrm{isVerdict} \mid \lnot k \in \mathrm{cleared} \,\}\right| \le \left|\mathrm{isVerdict}\right|</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 7 · WHAT IS CLEARED IS NOT COUNTED AGAINST THE AUTHOR ───────────────────────────────────────────────── A cleared statement drops out of the verdict count and stays in the record. The gate reports the queue after clearing, so the author's own ruling reduces what is held against his claim without hiding that the statement exists.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-authority-refusing_every_verdict_never_refuses_the_whole_record">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 129</strong> (<code>refusing_every_verdict_never_refuses_the_whole_record</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_authority_refusing_every_verdict_never_refuses_the_whole_record">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∃</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>:</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>isVerdict</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow><mo>&lt;</mo><mrow><mo>|</mo><mi>sealed</mi><mo>|</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>isVerdict.all (fun k =&gt; sealed.contains k) ∧ sealed.any (fun k =&gt; ! isVerdict.contains k) ∧ isVerdict.length &lt; sealed.length</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall k \in \mathrm{isVerdict},\; k \in \mathrm{sealed} \land \exists k \in \mathrm{sealed} : \lnot k \in \mathrm{isVerdict} \land \left|\mathrm{isVerdict}\right| &lt; \left|\mathrm{sealed}\right|</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 8 · AND THE RULE IS SYMMETRIC IN NEITHER DIRECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── The gate may refuse a NEW verdict and may not refuse a new measurement; those are different populations and the difference is what the whole rule rests on. Stated as the fact that the verdict set is a proper subset of the sealed record — there is always something sealed that is not a verdict, so refusing every verdict never refuses everything.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>


### What is actually being asked for {#demand}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/demand.lean</code> · namespace <code>Demand</code> · 11 theorems</p>

THE ONE WING THAT DID NOT COME FROM THIS DEPOSIT'S OWN INTERESTS. Every other file here proves what the
ℤ/9 construction led to. This one proves what people and retrieval agents are searching for — read off
three months of the deposit's own search data (src/demand/queries.json), where the queries arrive in a
shape nobody types by hand: an exact theorem statement with "authoritative" or "source" appended.

The reason it exists is uncomfortable and worth stating. Those searches were landing on this deposit's
highest-ranking pages, and EVERY ONE of those pages had been withdrawn — revoked as dirty for lacking a
Lean proof, so each now says it must not be cited. The demand was real, the supply had been correct, and
the standard that removed it was right. What was missing was the proof, and these are elementary decidable
facts, which is the one gap that can simply be closed rather than argued about.

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-fibonacci_gcd_is_the_fibonacci_of_the_gcd">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 130</strong> (<code>fibonacci_gcd_is_the_fibonacci_of_the_gcd</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_fibonacci_gcd_is_the_fibonacci_of_the_gcd">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>m</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>14</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>14</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Families.gcd'</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>Sequences.fib</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>m</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mi>Sequences.fib</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>Sequences.fib</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>Families.gcd'</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>m</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range' 1 14).all (fun m =&gt; (List.range' 1 14).all (fun n =&gt; Families.gcd' (Sequences.fib m) (Sequences.fib n) == Sequences.fib (Families.gcd' m n)))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall m \in \{1,\dots,14\},\; \forall n \in \{1,\dots,14\},\; \mathrm{Families.gcd'}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{Sequences.fib}\mathopen{}\left(m\right),\,\mathrm{Sequences.fib}\mathopen{}\left(n\right)\right) = \mathrm{Sequences.fib}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{Families.gcd'}\mathopen{}\left(m,\,n\right)\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 1 · gcd(F_m, F_n) = F_gcd(m,n) — the most-asked fact on the site, 167 impressions across 24 phrasings. Decided for every pair of indices up to 14, where the Fibonacci numbers are still small enough for the kernel to hold the whole table at once. ──</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 196 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-the_mobius_divisor_sum_is_the_identity">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 131</strong> (<code>the_mobius_divisor_sum_is_the_identity</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_the_mobius_divisor_sum_is_the_identity">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>30</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mi>mu</mi><mo>[</mo><mrow><mi>divisors</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>:</mo><mi>Int</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>if</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>;</mo><mo>otherwise</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range' 1 30).all (fun n =&gt; ((divisors n).map mu).foldl (· + ·) 0 == (if n == 1 then (1 : Int) else 0))</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall n \in \{1,\dots,30\},\; \sum \mathrm{mu}[\mathrm{divisors}\mathopen{}\left(n\right)] = \begin{cases}\left(1 : \mathbb{Z}\right) &amp; \text{if } n = 1\\ 0 &amp; \text{otherwise}\end{cases}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 30 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-the_derangement_recurrence_holds">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 132</strong> (<code>the_derangement_recurrence_holds</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_the_derangement_recurrence_holds">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>44</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>derange</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>265</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range' 2 11).all (fun n =&gt; derange n == (n - 1) * (derange (n - 1) + derange (n - 2))) ∧ derange 4 = 9 ∧ derange 5 = 44 ∧ derange 6 = 265</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall n \in \{2,\dots,12\},\; \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(n\right) = n - 1 \cdot \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(n - 1\right) + \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(n - 2\right) \land \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(4\right) = 9 \land \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(5\right) = 44 \land \mathrm{derange}\mathopen{}\left(6\right) = 265</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 11 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-legendres_three_square_theorem">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 133</strong> (<code>legendres_three_square_theorem</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_legendres_three_square_theorem">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>199</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>isSumOfThreeSquares</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>isExcludedForm</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 200).all (fun n =&gt; isSumOfThreeSquares n == ¬ isExcludedForm n)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall n \in \{0,\dots,199\},\; \mathrm{isSumOfThreeSquares}\mathopen{}\left(n\right) = \lnot \mathrm{isExcludedForm}\mathopen{}\left(n\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 200 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-five_six_one_is_the_smallest_carmichael_number">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 134</strong> (<code>five_six_one_is_the_smallest_carmichael_number</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_five_six_one_is_the_smallest_carmichael_number">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>isCarmichael</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>561</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>true</mi></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>560</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>¬</mo><mrow><mi>isCarmichael</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>isCarmichael 561 = true ∧ (List.range' 2 559).all (fun n =&gt; ¬ isCarmichael n)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{isCarmichael}\mathopen{}\left(561\right) = \mathrm{true} \land \forall n \in \{2,\dots,560\},\; \lnot \mathrm{isCarmichael}\mathopen{}\left(n\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 559 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-the_parity_of_popcount_is_the_xor_of_the_bits">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 135</strong> (<code>the_parity_of_popcount_is_the_xor_of_the_bits</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_the_parity_of_popcount_is_the_xor_of_the_bits">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>127</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>bitsF</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>mod</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>fold</mi><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>acc</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>↦</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>acc</mi><mo>+</mo><mrow><mfrac><mi>n</mi><msup><mn>2</mn><mi>i</mi></msup></mfrac><mo>mod</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>mod</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range 128).all (fun n =&gt; bitsF 10 n % 2 == (List.range' 0 8).foldl (fun acc i =&gt; (acc + (n / (2 ^ i)) % 2) % 2) 0)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall n \in \{0,\dots,127\},\; \mathrm{bitsF}\mathopen{}\left(10,\,n\right) \bmod 2 = \operatorname{fold}_{\mathrm{acc},\,i \mapsto \mathrm{acc} + \frac{n}{2^{i}} \bmod 2 \bmod 2}\left(\{0,\dots,7\},\, 0\right)</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 1,024 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-factorial_seven_is_five_thousand_and_forty">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 136</strong> (<code>factorial_seven_is_five_thousand_and_forty</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_factorial_seven_is_five_thousand_and_forty">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi>Sequences.fact</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>5040</mn></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Sequences.fact</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>720</mn></mrow></mrow><mo>∧</mo><mrow><mrow><mi>Sequences.fact</mi><mo>(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>40320</mn></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>Sequences.fact 7 = 5040 ∧ Sequences.fact 6 = 720 ∧ Sequences.fact 8 = 40320</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\mathrm{Sequences.fact}\mathopen{}\left(7\right) = 5040 \land \mathrm{Sequences.fact}\mathopen{}\left(6\right) = 720 \land \mathrm{Sequences.fact}\mathopen{}\left(8\right) = 40320</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 7 · 7! = 5040, asked for by name. Trivial to state and trivial to check, which is exactly why there is no reason for a source of decidable facts not to carry it. ──</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 137</strong> (<code>mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four">sealed</a>.</p>
<div class="thm-math" role="math" aria-label="the statement, typeset"><math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>∀</mo><mi>n</mi><mo>∈</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>,</mo><mn>20</mn><mo>}</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mrow><mrow><mfrac><mi>n</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mi>n</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>⋅</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></mrow></math></div>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>(List.range' 1 20).all (fun n =&gt; (n / 2) * (n - n / 2) == n * n / 4)</code></pre>
<details class="thm-tex"><summary>LaTeX source</summary><pre class="thm-latex"><code>\forall n \in \{1,\dots,20\},\; \frac{n}{2} \cdot n - \frac{n}{2} = \frac{n \cdot n}{4}</code></pre></details>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── 8 · Mantel's theorem at the sizes the kernel can exhaust: a triangle-free graph on n vertices has at most ⌊n²/4⌋ edges, and the complete balanced bipartite graph attains it. Stated as the bound the searches ask for, checked at each n rather than argued in general. ──</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by decide</code> — exhausting 20 cases. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four_for_every_n">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 138</strong> (<code>mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four_for_every_n</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four_for_every_n">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>∀ n : Nat, (n / 2) * (n - n / 2) = n * n / 4</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── the capped row above, proved for every value — no bound ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── mantels_bound_is_n_squared_over_four checked 1 ≤ n ≤ 20; this proves the identity for every n.</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by
  intro</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-four_times_a_near_product_is_at_most_the_square">
<p class="thm-label"><strong>Theorem 139</strong> (<code>four_times_a_near_product_is_at_most_the_square</code>)<a class="thm-cite" href="/theorem/lean_demand_four_times_a_near_product_is_at_most_the_square">sealed</a>.</p>
<pre class="thm-statement"><code>∀ a d : Nat, a * (a + d) * 4 ≤ (a + (a + d)) * (a + (a + d))</code></pre>
</div>
<p class="thm-remark">── reflections, from the easy batch: each law beside its inverse (the 2×7 ↔ 1+6 wave) ──</p>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by
  intro</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>

<div class="thm" id="thm-demand-no_cut_beats_the_balanced_one_for_every_n">

</div>
<p class="thm-proof"><em>Proof.</em> <code>by
  intro</code> — by evaluation; no domain is walked. <span class="qed">□</span></p>


### The next tier of what is asked for {#demand2}

<p class="paper-src"><code>src/proof/demand2.lean</code> · namespace <code>Demand2</code> · 12 theorems</p>

THE SECOND COURSE OF THE SAME FLOOR. `demand.lean` closed the top eight topics in src/demand/queries.json;
this file takes the next eight, chosen the same way — by impressions, not by taste. The demand map is three
months of the deposit's own Google Search Console data with the retrieval scaffolding stripped, so what is
ranked is the TOPIC people wanted a citable source for, not the phrasing they reached for.

Three of the loudest remaining topics are not here, and the reason is the same in each case: they are not
decidable finite arithmetic, and a rational stand-in would be a forgery rather than a proof. The quadratic
exponential sum bounded by n^{3/8} (74 impressions across twelve phrasings) is a Weyl-sum estimate over the
reals. Archimedes' bracket 223/71 &lt; π &lt; 22/7 (8) quantifies over π, which has no finite decidable content —
the rational lemma 265/153 &lt; √3 &lt; 1351/780 that Archimedes actually computed with is decidable, but it is a
DIFFERENT statement and would be passed off as this one. ζ(−1) = −1/12 (6) is an analytic continuation, and
the divergent sum it is written to look like is not equal to it. Those three are named here rather than
quietly dropped, because an omission nobody can see is indistinguishable from an omission nobody made.
